notes.title: Early Access launch confirmation!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that we will launch Space Simulator (ch.1 The Apollo Days ) , via Early-Access  on 21th December 2017. 

The first build will include/feature the entire Apollo 8 Mission. , with full SpaceCraft functionality , all working control , detailed missions, historically accurate facts ,etc..
